name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations and CRM Specialist
summary: Marketing operations specialist focused on CRM administration, marketing automation, and reporting. Administers CRMs in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Salesforce, has built 20+ automated workflows across lead capture, routing, nurture, and reactivation, and connects systems with Zapier, Make, and n8n. Sets up GA4 and Google Tag Manager on every site built, tracks conversions and campaign ROI, and turns the data into dashboards and clear recommendations. Brings 15+ years across MarTech, SaaS, and agency roles.

experience.title: Marketing Operations & CRM (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Architected a complete GoHighLevel marketing automation system of 20+ workflows: lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, appointment booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, long-term nurture and reactivation, and review generation.
Install and configure Google Tag Manager and GA4 on every website built, and implement tracking directly in HTML/CSS so leads and conversions are measured from day one.
Connect GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and client tools through Zapier, Make, and n8n using webhooks and APIs, writing Python and JavaScript in custom code steps where needed.
Administer CRMs in GoHighLevel and HubSpot with clean contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, and data-hygiene rules.
Build segmented email campaigns and automated sequences, including an audit workflow that enrolled 180+ businesses and converted 2 to paying clients.
Build dashboards in GA4, Power BI, and Excel tracking lead flow, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, and report results with recommendations.
